rooms.name: Empty lobby
rooms.desc: The turnstiles are dark. A corridor leads north, stairs go east.

rooms.name: Long corridor
rooms.desc: Wet floor signs everywhere. Someone is mopping ahead.

rooms.name: Closed cafeteria
rooms.desc: Chairs on tables. A vending machine hums in the corner.

rooms.name: Dim stairwell
rooms.desc: Concrete steps spiral down. A guard blocks the lower landing.

rooms.name: Basement archive
rooms.desc: Dusty shelves of old gradebooks. A door marked EXAM leads east.

rooms.name: Exam room
rooms.desc: One desk, one chair, one professor. Your gradebook lies open.
